block.ai_classify.model.title: AI Classify
block.ai_classify.model.description: Classify, extract fields, score sentiment or summarize text with an LLM.
block.ai_classify.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.ai_classify.ports_hint: Each category publishes on the output of the same name; result, error and unmatched are fixed. Apply in the General tab adds the outputs of new categories; delete unused outputs here.
block.ai_classify.help_mode: classify: route the message to its category. sentiment: route it by tone and add a score. extract: read declared fields into JSON. summarize: write a summary. Every mode publishes result.
block.ai_classify.help_multi_label: Off: at most one category. On: every category that applies; a copy goes to each of their outputs.
block.ai_classify.help_categories: Each category sends the unchanged message to the output of the same name. Messages that fit none go to unmatched. Apply adds the outputs of new categories.
block.ai_classify.help_sentiment_categor: The model picks exactly one label and a score from 0 (most negative) to 1 (most positive). The message goes to the output of that label.
block.ai_classify.help_fields: Missing values are null, never guessed. Values of the wrong type are null and listed in errors.
block.ai_classify.help_category_name: name: lowercase letters, digits and _ (at most 20). It is also the output name.
block.ai_classify.help_description: description: what belongs in this category, in plain words; the model reads it.
block.ai_classify.help_field_values: values: allowed values of an enum field, separated by commas.
block.ai_classify.help_field_description: description: what the field contains and where to find it; the model reads it.
block.ai_classify.help_sample: Calls the configured endpoint once with the settings being edited, including unapplied changes. Nothing is saved, routed or published. Endpoints that need api_key_ref cannot be tested here.
block.ai_classify.card_invalid: Invalid settings: open the block to fix them.
block.ai_classify.outputs_fixed_mode: In this mode only result and error receive messages.
block.ai_classify.outputs_unused: Outputs no category uses: {unused}. They never receive messages; delete or rename them in the Ports tab.
block.ai_classify.outputs_add_unused: Apply adds the outputs {missing}. Outputs no category uses: {unused}; delete or rename them in the Ports tab.
block.ai_classify.hidden_mode_error: The settings of mode {modes} need a fix: select that mode to see them.
block.ai_classify.fix_errors: Not applied: fix the highlighted settings first.
block.ai_classify.preview_invalid: Fix the highlighted settings to test them.
block.ai_classify.preview_routed: The message would be sent to {outputs}.
block.ai_classify.preview_unmatched: No category fits: the message would be sent to unmatched.
block.ai_classify.preview_truncated: The reply was longer than summary_max_chars and was cut.
block.ai_classify.field_type_mismatch: The value does not have the declared type.
block.ai_classify.field_invalid_date: The value is not a valid YYYY-MM-DD date.
block.ai_classify.field_not_allowed: The value is not one of the allowed values.
block.ai_classify.field_required_missing: This required field was not found in the text.
block.ai_classify.code_input: The message cannot be analyzed: check the text or text_path.
block.ai_classify.code_input_too_long: The text is longer than max_input_chars, or needs more than max_chunks parts.
block.ai_classify.code_secret: The wallet secret is unavailable: unlock the wallet and check api_key_ref.
block.ai_classify.code_network: The endpoint could not be reached, or its address is not allowed by the settings.
block.ai_classify.code_timeout: The model did not answer within timeout_sec.
block.ai_classify.code_auth: The endpoint refused the credentials; check api_key_ref.
block.ai_classify.code_rate_limited: The endpoint is rate limiting or timed out; retry later.
block.ai_classify.code_provider_rejected: The endpoint rejected the request; check api_base_url, model, api_style and structured_output.
block.ai_classify.code_provider_unavaila: The endpoint failed or is unavailable.
block.ai_classify.code_http_status: The endpoint returned an unexpected HTTP status.
block.ai_classify.code_provider_response: The endpoint response is malformed, compressed or too large.
block.ai_classify.code_refused: The model refused to process this text.
block.ai_classify.code_invalid_reply: The model reply could not be used, even after one retry.
block.ai_classify.code_unknown_label: The model named a category that is not declared, even after one retry.
block.ai_classify.code_internal: The text could not be analyzed.
block.ai_classify.err_sample_too_large: The sample is longer than {max} characters.
block.ai_classify.err_preview_wallet: The editor cannot read the wallet, so an endpoint that needs api_key_ref can only be tested in a Run.
block.ai_classify.err_config_type: The settings must be a JSON object.
block.ai_classify.err_integer_invalid: {key} must be an integer from {min} to {max}.
block.ai_classify.err_max_tokens_invalid: max_output_tokens must be 0 (not sent) or an integer from 16 to 65536.
block.ai_classify.err_temperature_invali: temperature must be empty (not sent) or a number from 0 to 2.
block.ai_classify.err_model_invalid: model must be a model name without spaces (at most 200 characters).
block.ai_classify.err_secret_ref_invalid: api_key_ref must be empty or a wallet reference such as secret://workspace/llm_key; never paste the key itself.
block.ai_classify.err_instructions_inval: instructions must be text of at most {max} characters.
block.ai_classify.err_text_path_invalid: text_path must be empty or a path such as body.message or items[0].text.
block.ai_classify.err_ca_file_invalid: ca_file must be empty or an absolute PEM file path.
block.ai_classify.err_url_invalid: api_base_url must be an ASCII http(s) URL without spaces.
block.ai_classify.err_url_port_invalid: api_base_url has an invalid host or port.
block.ai_classify.err_url_credentials: api_base_url must not contain credentials; use api_key_ref.
block.ai_classify.err_url_query: api_base_url must not contain a query or fragment.
block.ai_classify.err_url_host_invalid: api_base_url has an invalid host name.
block.ai_classify.err_url_address_blocke: api_base_url points to a link-local, multicast or unspecified address.
block.ai_classify.err_url_path_invalid: The api_base_url path must be a plain API root such as /v1.
block.ai_classify.err_insecure_http: Plain HTTP to a non-loopback host requires allow_insecure_http.
block.ai_classify.err_key_over_http: An API key is only sent over HTTPS or to a loopback host.
block.ai_classify.err_list_type: {list} must be a list of objects with name and description.
block.ai_classify.err_item_type: Each entry must be an object.
block.ai_classify.err_category_name_inva: {name} is not a valid category name: use 1 to 20 lowercase letters, digits and single underscores, like billing_question.
block.ai_classify.err_category_name_rese: {name} is a reserved output name; choose another name.
block.ai_classify.err_description_invali: The description must be text of at most {max} characters.
block.ai_classify.err_enum_values_missin: An enum field needs 1 to {max} allowed values.
block.ai_classify.err_enum_value_invalid: Allowed values are non-empty texts of at most 100 characters, without leading or trailing spaces.
block.ai_classify.err_enum_value_duplica: An allowed value is listed twice.
block.ai_classify.err_fields_empty: Declare at least one field to extract.
block.ai_classify.err_field_name_invalid: {name} is not a valid field name: start with a letter or _, then letters, digits or _ (at most 64).
block.ai_classify.err_field_type_invalid: type must be string, number, boolean, date, enum or list.
block.ai_classify.err_values_not_enum: Allowed values apply to enum fields only.
block.ai_classify.err_required_type: required must be true or false.
block.ai_classify.err_fixed_output_missi: The {name} output (port {port}) is missing from this block.
block.ai_classify.err_category_output_co: {name} is the name of a fixed output; choose another name.
block.ai_classify.err_category_output_mi: Category {name} has no output named {name}: apply the settings to add it, or add it in the Ports tab.
block.ai_classify.err_outputs_too_many: This block can have at most {max} outputs; remove unused outputs in the Ports tab first.
block.ai_classify.help_summary_max_chars: Maximum length of the final summary in characters (100 to 20000). Longer replies are cut at a word or a whole bullet and flagged truncated.
block.ai_classify.help_summary_style: bullets: a list of short points. paragraph: one block of text.
block.ai_classify.help_summary_language: same: the language of the text. en: English. fr: French.
block.ai_classify.help_api_base_url: OpenAI-compatible API root; the block calls <api_base_url>/chat/completions or /responses. Loopback servers (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM) work as is; other hosts need allow_remote.
block.ai_classify.help_model: Model name sent to the endpoint. Prefer a model that follows JSON instructions reliably.
block.ai_classify.help_api_key_ref: Optional wallet reference for a Bearer API key, e.g. secret://workspace/llm_key. Never paste the key itself.
block.ai_classify.help_api_style: chat_completions: POST /chat/completions, supported by most servers. responses: POST /responses (OpenAI Responses API).
block.ai_classify.help_structured_output: Ask the endpoint for JSON that follows a JSON schema (response_format json_schema). Turn off if the server rejects it; the reply is validated either way.
block.ai_classify.help_temperature: Sampling temperature from 0 to 2. 0 gives the most repeatable answers. Leave empty to let the server decide (some reasoning models refuse this parameter).
block.ai_classify.help_max_output_tokens: Maximum tokens of one reply (16 to 65536), or 0 to not send a limit. A reply cut by this limit counts as invalid.
block.ai_classify.help_timeout_sec: Total time allowed for one message, every request and the retry included (1 to 600 seconds).
block.ai_classify.help_instructions: Optional context added to the model instructions, e.g. who writes the texts. At most 4000 characters.
block.ai_classify.help_text_path: Empty: analyze the whole message. Otherwise a path in a JSON message, e.g. body.message or items[0].text; it must lead to a text.
block.ai_classify.help_max_input_chars: Longest text accepted, in characters (default 100000). A longer text is refused on error.
block.ai_classify.help_chunk_chars: summarize: texts longer than this are summarized in parts of about this many characters, then combined.
block.ai_classify.help_max_chunks: summarize: maximum number of parts of one text (1 to 64).
block.ai_classify.help_allow_remote: Allow a non-loopback endpoint (LAN or Internet). Off by default; link-local and metadata addresses stay blocked.
block.ai_classify.help_allow_insecure_ht: Allow plain HTTP to a non-loopback host. An API key is never sent this way.
block.ai_classify.help_ca_file: Optional absolute path of a PEM CA file for an HTTPS endpoint with a private certificate authority.
block.ai_classify.help_max_response_byte: Largest endpoint response accepted, in bytes.
